config.hypothesis: Affine shape adaptation on the DSP-SIFT baseline may spread valid local constraints and recover the office held-out regression; verify both scenes before considering any production change.
config.gate: Require complete registration and no scene-level PSNR or SSIM loss in both repeats; any production adoption additionally requires comparison to stock SIFT. Increased point count is not an optimization claim.
config.cache: Fresh SfM database per run; OS disk cache not purged; GPU training serial.

reference_implementation.scope: Read only; CUDA setup and learned-depth initialization were not installed or benchmarked.
